fixed_point_theorem.messages: Each directed subtree message is the exact feasible subset of the separator bit {0},{1},{0,1}, or empty together with the edge xor relation used for back-substitution.
fixed_point_theorem.name: CROSS_SCALE_POST_CREDIT_FIXED_POINT_ESTABLISHED
fixed_point_theorem.proof: Leaf elimination is exact because b_leaf xor b_parent=c is a bijection over F2. Inductively eliminating a leaf preserves the exact projection on the remaining tree. At the final root the feasible root set is exact; reversing eliminations reconstructs exactly all joint assignments. Repeating upward/downward messages reaches the same fixed feasible set as solving the full tree system at once.
